Question 19

The line 3y+x=12 intercepts the x- and y-axes at points A and B, respectively. If the segment AB― is a diameter of a circle, find the equation of the circle.

a
(x−3)2+(y−1)2=40
b
(x−6)2+(y−2)2=40
c
(x−3)2+(y−1)2=10
d
(x−3)2+(y−1)2=210
e
(x−6)2+(y−2)2=10
